notes.title: Exitium Update 1.0.11
notes.content:
[b]HAPPY NEW YEAR EVERYONE![/b]
Here are the improvements and bug fixes from the latest update:
Have fun playing Exitium!

[u]Change log Exitium version 1.0.11:[/u]

[b]Changes:[/b]
 - Made it easier to spot "the boyfriend".
 - Added a visual feedback when the player can successfully scare "the boyfriend".
 - Changed HUD position to be more user-friendly.
 - Improved tutorials.
 - Slowed down the great wheel to prevent to falling of it.
 - Stabilized the saucers in the chapter 11 to enhance controls.
 - Made it so the player can move while using the scare ability.
 - Made it so the player will change level faster after a successful scare.
 - Reworked the first puzzle in chapter 15 to be slightly easier.
 - Made some AI more responsive to the player skill.
 - Changed some typo size.
 - Minor graphical changes.
 - Replaced some IAs in chapter 13.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
 - Fixed a bug in which the player could get stuck falling in the first puzzle of chapter 13.
 - Fixed a bug in which the player is able to save an already passed savepoint.
 - Fixed a bug in which the player could grip at nothing.
 - Fixed a bug in which AI deals twice the damages on the first attack.
 - Fixed a bug in which a music in game would interrupt another.
 - Fixed a bug in which some items weren't saved.
 - Fixed a bug in which the portal wouldn't display in the first time you enter a chapter.
 - Fixed a bug in which the player couldn't scare "the boyfriend" in chapter 8.
 - Fixed a bug in which the camera would get stuck in the final chapter.
 - Fixed some unwanted sounds playing right after the player reloads a save.
 - Fixed a bug in which the player could delay the arrival of the final boss.
